ModMetaData.name: Covetheus (No HAR)
ModMetaData.author: Lelbaro, Zaljerem, RhombusMaximus
ModMetaData.description:
Covetheus without the Humanoid Alien Races (HAR) dependency.
Includes the Artificial Person (Android) race, USCSS Colony mission scenario, and Covetheus apparel — all using vanilla RimWorld systems. No HAR required.
Artificial Person Race: Android based on the Alien franchise's Walter/David series. Gender-neutral, no life stages, high immunity, low flammability, no sleep needed. Custom backstories for USCSS crew roles.
USCSS Colony Mission Scenario: Start with 7 human colonists + 1 Artificial Person arriving in drop pods. Includes F90 rifles, survival supplies, and custom game start dialog.
Apparel: USCSS Hoodies (male/female variants), Casual Jumpsuits, Trapper Hats, Backpack with camera and solar panel.
HAR Removal: Converted from AlienRace.ThingDef_AlienRace to vanilla ThingDef with renderTree=Humanlike. All backstories converted to vanilla BackstoryDef. No mod dependencies required.
Credits: Original mod by Lelbaro. 1.4/1.5 update by Zaljerem. 1.6 port and HAR removal by RhombusMaximus.
Based on: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2077371272
